units: Dated events and approximate named-place coordinates in longitude/latitude degrees
note: Original paraphrases linked to institutional histories and primary documents. Markers locate cities or regions, not territorial extent, exact ceremonies or front lines. Years are conventional historical years; dates before 1582 follow the historical Julian calendar unless noted.

items.title: Münster
items.text: The imperial peace with France was concluded at Münster in 1648.

items.title: Osnabrück
items.text: The imperial peace with Sweden was concluded at Osnabrück in 1648.

items.title: Imperial religious settlement
items.text: The treaties set a religious and constitutional settlement within the Empire; Regensburg is an institutional locator, not a signing location.

items.title: Regensburg’s continuing Diet
items.text: The Perpetual Diet began in 1663, demonstrating imperial institutions continued after the peace.
